articles.summary: At JustAI, we’ve built an AI-first decisioning platform that continuously learns and adapts, in real time, using reinforcement learning (RL) and large language model (LLM) optimization. This means better personalization, faster learning cycles, and measurable lift without additional manual testing overhead.
articles.title: How JustAI uses reinforcement learning to power AI marketing

articles.summary: Coursera and JustAI share a bold vision: build AI-native systems that make personalization effortless, scalable, and ROI-positive. Coursera has long led the charge in applying AI across learning, using it to create courses, coach learners, and assess progress. Just Words brings that same intelligence to lifecycle marketing, making it easy for teams to run hundreds of tests, personalize at scale, and surface insights automatically, without relying on engineers or analysts.
articles.title: Coursera scales personalization with JustAI decisioning
